# PROCESS — cand_0003 (parent cand_0001, the current champion)

Method confirmed from source (read-only): the adapter recalculates every output with
LibreOffice `--convert-to xlsx` (`adapter.py:_recalc_workbook`) BEFORE the scorer opens it
`data_only=True`, so standard formulas DO recalc and pass — this is why 11 formula-writers
pass 3/3. The scorer (`evaluation.py: transform_value`/`compare_cell_value`) compares each
answer cell by **value AND Python type**: numbers rounded to 2 dp; a numeric string parses to
float (so "511.7"==511.7); but a string that does NOT parse as a plain number ("$1,234", "12%",
a text date) has type `str` and never equals a numeric/date GT; datetimes compared as rounded
Excel serial; times to the minute; ""≈None. These facts ground every contract edit below.

Diagnosis was fan-out: 7 read-only subagents, one per group, covering all 37 failing traces.

## Ranked cluster list (leverage = # failing tasks × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Invents own model; ignores the method already in the workbook | 42930 (VLOOKUP table sits in E:F), 6698 (paraphrased an exact COUNTIFS), 45944 (inverted lookup dir), 39946, 398-14, 10281, 14207, 48983, 50755 | Agent reverse-engineers a fancier/paraphrased rule that fits sample-1, ignores the helper table / reference formula / example row present in the sheet, then "verifies" against its own logic → diverges on hidden files 2/3 | KNOWLEDGE / worked-example |
| 2 | Reads only the answer_position window | 250-20 (2/3; data extends below row 20), 157-4, 269-44 | Bounds READ to the write window; consolidation/deletion pulls lower rows up, and hidden files have more rows | CONTRACT |
| 3 | Type/format infidelity | 55224 (time written as text vs a `datetime.time` example cell), 585-41 (numbers→text), 50486/4225 (re-cased label) | Writes the right content in the wrong Python type → scorer's type check fails | CONTRACT (verified vs scorer) |
| 4 | Dynamic-array / spilling / add-in formulas | 50526 (FILTER), 50631 (array WORKDAY spill), 53062, 55039 | Agent computed correct literals but wrote a spilling/dynamic-array formula; LibreOffice recalc leaves it BLANK → 0 | KNOWLEDGE (narrowing) |
| 5 | Temporal drift | 32023 | Prompt's `datetime.now()` rule (=2026) can't reproduce the frozen (~2024) GT | CONFLICT (fix a wrong existing rule) |

## ENVIRONMENT faults — flagged, NOT prose-fixed
- **34-5**: agent's produced values are CORRECT, but LibreOffice recalc renames sheet `SHEET1`→
  `SHEET1 -1` (it does this even to the pristine input), so `compare_workbooks` cannot find the
  answer sheet → 0/3 on all cases. This is a harness/LibreOffice defect, not a capability gap. A
  human must handle the sheet-rename in the recalc step. No prompt edit can fix it.
- **146-49**: pre-flagged infra noise (aborted trials). Untouched.

## Edits kept (all additive/narrowing; verify + blast-radius per edit)
| cluster | file | edit | verify-the-fix | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | prompt.md (WRITE GENERAL CODE) + task_template.md (INSPECT) | "The intended computation is often ALREADY in the workbook … replicate its exact lookup direction / sign operators / first-vs-last match"; INSPECT now scans other columns/sheets for a helper/lookup table/reference formula | trace 42930 ignored the E:F subdivision→number table and re-derived its own ordering (passed TC1, failed TC2/3); 6698 paraphrased `SUM(COUNTIFS(B>0…,C<0…))` as "B or C ≠ 0". Rule makes the agent reuse the existing table/formula semantics. | BOUNDED: conditional on an existing method being present; the 11 formula-passers already reuse existing patterns (reinforced), computation-only passers have no such cell so unchanged. |
| 2 | prompt.md (WRITE GENERAL CODE) | "answer_position bounds only WHERE you WRITE; READ the full data region to the real last row; deletion pulls survivors up; nothing-changed/gaps = red flag" | trace 250-20 read only rows 2-20; TC2 has data below row 20 that shifts up into A1:J20. Reading full region fixes it. 157-4 deleted zero rows (should have been a red flag). | BOUNDED: passers that already read correctly are unchanged (reading past non-existent data returns nothing). cand_0002 shipped this exact rule; its 4 breaks were non-scope tasks. |
| 3 | prompt.md (new MATCH VALUE AND TYPE block) | numbers as real numbers (no `$`/`,`/`%`); dates & times as real datetime/time (carry number_format); copy text verbatim (no re-casing unless instructed); mirror an example cell's type/format | trace 55224 wrote `"00:34:49"` (str) where the example cell F2 is `datetime.time`; scorer transforms GT time→"00:34", agent str stays "00:34:49" → type/value mismatch. 585-41 wrote numbers as text. Matches `transform_value`/`compare_cell_value` exactly. | BOUNDED: passing tasks already emit correct types (that is why they pass); the block only states the scorer's actual contract. |
| 4 | prompt.md (PRODUCE THE RESULT block) | "standard formulas recalc & pass; dynamic-array/spilling (FILTER/SORT/UNIQUE/SEQUENCE/spilling XLOOKUP) & array-spill formulas often come back BLANK → compute the literal in Python" | traces 50526 (FILTER) & 50631 (array WORKDAY) wrote spilling formulas → blank cells → 0, though the agent had already computed the right literals. | BOUNDED: verified none of the 11 passing formula-writers use any dynamic-array/add-in function (grep). Even if one did, a runtime-computed literal also passes, so no regression is possible. |
| 5 | prompt.md (WRITE GENERAL CODE) | replaced the flat `datetime.now()` rule with a frozen-GT rule: sandbox clock reads a much later date and won't reproduce the frozen expected file; if a worked example pins "today", calibrate to it; still never hard-code an observed date | trace 32023 used `datetime.now()`=2026 → every dated assignment is past → all employees resolve to the last column; GT frozen ~2024 (example "…changes to C78 on 1/6/24"). | BOUNDED: GT files are static/frozen, so NO passing task can rely on `datetime.now()`=2026 reproducing a "today" answer; only date-example tasks change, all currently failing. |

## Deliberately did NOT re-try (cand_0002 was REJECTED, net-zero, broke {254-34,267-18,56561,567-21})
- The step-3 VERIFY rewrite ("verify independently / reconsider your READING, not one cell") —
  most likely made narrowly-passing tasks (254-34 VBA-paste) second-guess a correct answer. Kept
  cand_0001's accepted VERIFY step untouched.
- The "the blue column → inspect fills to locate a colored column" bullet — likely broke 267-18
  (theme-color detection). Not re-added.
- The "no embellishment / leave #N/A / do not fill blank cells" block — global behavioral rule with
  unbounded blast radius; a likely breaker. Not re-added.
- Re-tested nothing from cand_0001's `broke` set as a NEW edit; kept its accepted blocks intact.

## Deliberately skipped (no safe general fix this iteration)
- 269-44 (VBA row-shift semantics + noted ill-posed in JOURNAL), 55912 (garbled instruction),
  58484/58890/32975/49782 (task-specific heuristic/edge, data-dependent), 53305/413-15/39946
  (very ambiguous multi-criteria layout — interpretation, no general rule), 4225 (unknowable label
  casing quirk). These are one-offs, not a shared prose-fixable class.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 7 parallel read-only diagnosis agents (one per trace group) covering all 37 failing
  tasks; findings cross-checked against the scorer source before any edit. Edits applied serially
  in this one candidate (no worktree merge needed).
